# The scripts of tools/ on their own, against a store written by hand: the edge cases that the agent paths do not reach.
[!exec:jq] skip
isolate
! exec bd version
! exec gh version

rdinit
rdfakes
env HOME=$WORK/home
env PATH=$WORK/fake:$PATH
env RESEARCH_HOME=$WORK/store
env SEARCH_API=http://search.test
env WIKI_API=http://wiki.test
mkdir store/r1/snap
mkdir store/r1/s2.1
cp page.txt store/r1/snap/s1.txt

# A quote with a newline is refused. A fixed-string search treats each line of it as a pattern, and an empty line matches every line of the page.
stdin quote-newline.json
exec sh rd/tools/claims.sh add r1 1 1
stdout 'REJECT'
exec jq -r '.quote_ok' store/r1/s1.1/claims.jsonl
stdout 'false'
# A quote with a tab is refused too: the staleness table splits its rows at tabs.
stdin quote-tab.json
exec sh rd/tools/claims.sh add r1 1 2
stdout 'REJECT'
# A quote on one line of the page is accepted.
stdin quote-good.json
exec sh rd/tools/claims.sh add r1 1 3
! stdout 'REJECT'

# A number in the prose must be a whole number of a cited quote: 3 is not in 30 percent.
cp claims-cited.jsonl store/r1/s2.1/claims.jsonl
cp prose-substring.md store/r1/s2.1/prose.md
! exec sh rd/tools/cites.sh $WORK/store r1 2 1
stdout 'states the number 3, which is not in a cited quote'
cp prose-whole.md store/r1/s2.1/prose.md
exec sh rd/tools/cites.sh $WORK/store r1 2 1

# A search that fails is an error, not an empty list.
! exec sh rd/tools/search.sh nothing 3
! stdout .

# A fetch refuses an address with user information, the 172.16 range and a bracketed address.
! exec sh rd/tools/fetch.sh r1 http://x@127.0.0.1/page
stderr 'private network'
! exec sh rd/tools/fetch.sh r1 http://172.20.0.5/page
stderr 'private network'
! exec sh rd/tools/fetch.sh r1 'http://[::1]/page'
stderr 'IPv6'

# A staleness check that tested no quote fails.
! exec sh rd/tools/staleness.sh $WORK/store nothing-here
stdout 'no quote to test'

-- page.txt --
Winter tests.
At -20 C the output fell by 30 percent.
-- quote-newline.json --
[{"text":"A claim.","source":1,"quote":"not on the page\n\nAt -20 C the output fell by 30 percent."}]
-- quote-tab.json --
[{"text":"A claim.","source":1,"quote":"Winter\ttests."}]
-- quote-good.json --
[{"text":"A claim.","source":1,"quote":"At -20 C the output fell by 30 percent."}]
-- claims-cited.jsonl --
{"id":"c1","text":"Cold cut it.","source":"s1","quote":"At -20 C the output fell by 30 percent.","quote_ok":true,"canary":false,"verdict":"supported"}
-- prose-substring.md --
The output fell by 3 percent. [c1]
-- prose-whole.md --
The output fell by 30 percent. [c1]
